new_notation.F: One of the two transported checkerboard surfaces f(beta1),f(omega1).
new_notation.C_F: Cellulation by intersections with the upper/lower spheres. Faces are domes; fat interior vertices are saddle disks; edges are subarcs of the sphere intersections.
new_notation.transverse_interior_edge: The projections of the two adjacent dome boundary curves cross at that edge; otherwise nontransverse.
new_notation.A_F: Regions of D2 of the color of F incident to exactly one crossing.
new_notation.Lambda_F: Components of the indicated upper/lower sphere intersections which do NOT bound disk regions of D2.
new_notation.Gamma_F: Crossing balls of D2 good for F; the actual earlier goodness definition is NOT supplied.
new_notation.Z_F: Boundary edges of C_F not meeting any crossing ball of D2.
new_notation.Sigma_F: Saddle intersections of F with crossing balls.
new_notation.kappa_F: Components bounding disk regions of the corresponding color; introduced in6.3.

6_1_exact_counting_contract.statement: A relation R_F subset Lambda_F times (Gamma_F disjoint-union Sigma_F disjoint-union A_F disjoint-union Z_F) has exactly2witnesses over each Lambda component; every Gamma/Sigma witness is used at most2times, every A/Z witness at most1time.
proof_architecture: Components with one interior edge use the one-crossing-region and good-ball witnesses. For a component with no transverse edge, two Z witnesses are forced: otherwise odd intersection parity with the projection graph or failure of alternation occurs (Fig6.2).

With a transverse edge, an outermost entry/exit argument selects two disjoint subarcs of a neighboring dome curve inside the projection of C. A subarc containing Z gives that witness. Otherwise it runs on boundary X2 and its exit is at a crossing ball, producing a good-ball or saddle witness.

The two selected subarcs cannot give the same witness. There is room for only one underpass exit; mixed underpass/saddle or distinct-saddle cases violate the saddle conditions, with an explicit reference to3.1(ii). The same-saddle configuration is precisely the diagram excluded by5.5.
